items.title: Northern Ireland promoted to Nations League top tier with draw in Hungary
items.summary: Justin Devenny's superb strike saw Northern Ireland earn promotion to the top tier of the Nations League with a hard-fought 1-1 draw away to closest challengers Hungary in Budapest.

items.title: Parrott fires Republic of Ireland into Nations League play-offs
items.summary: Troy Parrott fired the Republic of Ireland into a Nations League play-off berth with two penalties in their 3-0 victory over 10-man Kosovo at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin.
